images.name: Elemente
images.prompt: Create exactly ONE original small fantasy spell-school icon for the Aleria encyclopedia, in the visual tradition of the hand-painted spell UI icons from The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion. STYLE references are the provided existing icons, not edit targets: match their simple colored central glyphs, expressive deep warm sepia contours, ivory highlights, muted jewel-colored fills, and irregular antique copper curved bracket/ring surrounding the glyph with a tapered ornamental tip. Invent new artwork, do not copy a reference emblem. Compact strong silhouette that remains readable at 56 pixels. Gently hand-painted flat icon, slight pigment texture, restrained dimensional highlights. One single emblem centered, no square plaque, no parchment, no background disc, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no elaborate scene, no realistic lighting, no neon glow. Genuinely transparent alpha background including outside the emblem and open spaces inside; not a checkerboard painting. Subject occupies about 84 percent of a square image with clean transparent padding. Subject: A four-part elemental wheel: one red flame, one pale blue water curl, one ochre angular stone, one ivory lightning fork, fused into a SINGLE simple four-armed central glyph. Fiery red and storm blue accents.
